run_policy: Three sequential independent processes per repository; original seed/shapes/warmup=50/repeats=100. No competing benchmark processes. First trial is the primary result; repeat trials are retained without selecting the best trial.
comparison_limit: The original machine used torch 2.5.1+cu121. Hardware, driver and software differ; cross-machine ratios cannot isolate hardware improvement.
